title: 5G/Wireless Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build from telecommunications fundamentals into 5G radio access, RF engineering, wireless network planning, optimisation and eventually advanced 5G/6G systems.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. from 2026–2030. If a four-year honours/research option is available, use the additional academic depth for advanced wireless communications, RF, antennas, network simulation or research.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Build electronics, signals, communication, RF and networking fundamentals and complete wireless projects/internships.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Specialise in 5G RAN, RF engineering, wireless planning, network optimisation, testing or Open RAN.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Progress into senior RAN/RF, wireless network design, optimisation, systems engineering or technical leadership.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Combine 5G/6G, Open RAN, AI/ML, edge computing, automation and advanced wireless technologies.
